mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate sharp consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS does not decline, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply shocks (INDPRO growth below 0.5% for two months) trigger inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of manufacturing supply shocks, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts reflect strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, consistently driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate growth momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment decline and unemployment rate rise indicate severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession expectations intensify.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when PAYEMS does not decline or UNRATE does not rise, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and GDP growth signal recessionary supply shocks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03 over 3-year window.
